final_answer:
Yes. Two CAPAs trace back to the same unrepaired defect on incubator INC-03, even though the deviations record different root causes.

**The shared cause: the INC-03 door switch/latch defect was never fixed.**

- **CAPA-26-012** (corrective, owner Engineering, still OPEN and past its 31-Mar-2026 due date) came from **DEV-26-011**. During OQ test TC-OQ-INC-04 on INC-03, the door-open alarm sounded at 142 s against a limit of 60 s. The recorded root cause is "Door switch misaligned." The CAPA action is to replace the INC-03 door switch and re-execute TC-OQ-INC-04. The linked change control **CC-26-019** (door switch replacement) is "APPROVED - NOT IMPLEMENTED".
- **CAPA-26-015** (corrective, closed 3-Jul-2026, effectiveness still PENDING) came from **DEV-26-033**. During PPQ26-02, the INC-03 door was found not fully latched on 11-Jun-2026, and the door alarm was acknowledged at 07:50. The recorded root cause is operator error ("did not confirm door latch per SOP-MFG-105"). The CAPA's only action is operator retraining on the door latch check. The trace links also tie DEV-26-033 directly to INC-03 (link 165), and the deviation's own description names the INC-03 door.

The door-switch defect identified in February was never corrected, so the door failed to latch again in June. The June deviation was attributed to the operator, and the CAPA addressed only that. The equipment fix (CAPA-26-012 / CC-26-019) is still outstanding. Equipment-event records also show INC-03 door and low-temperature alarms on 10–11 June 2026 (EV-26-0012, EV-26-0013). PPQ26-02 then failed the harvest viability criterion (75.2% vs ≥80%) and its day 7–8 viability dropped on INC-03.

**Checked and not linked:**
- **CAPA-26-008** (FRZ-80-02 compressor) and **CAPA-26-019** (tubing-set supplier defect, DEV-26-041) have unrelated causes and no link to INC-03.
- **CAPA-26-016** (from DEV-26-027, low %CAR+ in ENG26-01/02, attributed to donor CD3%) does not share this cause. ENG26-01 ran on INC-02, not INC-03. The donor-variability explanation is also weak, since its CD3% values were not clearly lower than the batches that performed normally.

**Recommendation:** Treat CAPA-26-015 as incomplete. Its effectiveness check is pending, and it should be linked to CAPA-26-012 and the unimplemented CC-26-019. The INC-03 door switch should be replaced and TC-OQ-INC-04 re-executed before INC-03 is used again for GMP runs.

content.text:
Yes. Two CAPAs trace back to the same unrepaired defect on incubator INC-03, even though the deviations record different root causes.

**The shared cause: the INC-03 door switch/latch defect was never fixed.**

- **CAPA-26-012** (corrective, owner Engineering, still OPEN and past its 31-Mar-2026 due date) came from **DEV-26-011**. During OQ test TC-OQ-INC-04 on INC-03, the door-open alarm sounded at 142 s against a limit of 60 s. The recorded root cause is "Door switch misaligned." The CAPA action is to replace the INC-03 door switch and re-execute TC-OQ-INC-04. The linked change control **CC-26-019** (door switch replacement) is "APPROVED - NOT IMPLEMENTED".
- **CAPA-26-015** (corrective, closed 3-Jul-2026, effectiveness still PENDING) came from **DEV-26-033**. During PPQ26-02, the INC-03 door was found not fully latched on 11-Jun-2026, and the door alarm was acknowledged at 07:50. The recorded root cause is operator error ("did not confirm door latch per SOP-MFG-105"). The CAPA's only action is operator retraining on the door latch check. The trace links also tie DEV-26-033 directly to INC-03 (link 165), and the deviation's own description names the INC-03 door.

The door-switch defect identified in February was never corrected, so the door failed to latch again in June. The June deviation was attributed to the operator, and the CAPA addressed only that. The equipment fix (CAPA-26-012 / CC-26-019) is still outstanding. Equipment-event records also show INC-03 door and low-temperature alarms on 10–11 June 2026 (EV-26-0012, EV-26-0013). PPQ26-02 then failed the harvest viability criterion (75.2% vs ≥80%) and its day 7–8 viability dropped on INC-03.

**Checked and not linked:**
- **CAPA-26-008** (FRZ-80-02 compressor) and **CAPA-26-019** (tubing-set supplier defect, DEV-26-041) have unrelated causes and no link to INC-03.
- **CAPA-26-016** (from DEV-26-027, low %CAR+ in ENG26-01/02, attributed to donor CD3%) does not share this cause. ENG26-01 ran on INC-02, not INC-03. The donor-variability explanation is also weak, since its CD3% values were not clearly lower than the batches that performed normally.

**Recommendation:** Treat CAPA-26-015 as incomplete. Its effectiveness check is pending, and it should be linked to CAPA-26-012 and the unimplemented CC-26-019. The INC-03 door switch should be replaced and TC-OQ-INC-04 re-executed before INC-03 is used again for GMP runs.
